email_draft.subject: 25 Denver owner/rental signals worth checking?
email_draft.body:
Hi {company},

I’m testing a Denver owner-lead radar for property managers.

I pulled 25 sample property signals from public Denver records — recent-sale absentee owners, small multifamily, entity-owned rentals, out-of-state owners, and high-value assets. I would not expect every record to be useful. The test is simple: are at least 2–3 worth checking further?

Sample: https://agent-path.vercel.app/radar/denver-sample/

If 2–3 look worth a closer look, I can reserve a Denver territory and send a protected weekly feed.

Worth a quick look?

Nick
Agent Path

call_script: Hi, this is Nick with Agent Path. I just sent a short email with a Denver owner/rental sample. We’re testing whether property managers want a weekly radar of public-record signals — recent-sale absentee owners, small multifamily, LLC-owned rentals, out-of-state owners. The sample has 25 records. I’m not claiming every one is a lead. I’m trying to learn whether 2 or 3 are worth checking further. Who’s the right person to review owner acquisition opportunities?
recording_script: Quick note: I may record this call so I can capture feedback accurately. Is that okay?
